create_vlm_model: create a HuggingFaceTransformersVlmModel instance to run vision-language model inference on document pages
run_vlm_prediction: run VLM prediction on a batch of document pages and generate text responses from images
formulate_vlm_prompt: formulate a prompt for a vision-language model with image and text content for document processing
configure_quantized_model: configure a quantized VLM model with 8-bit precision for memory-efficient inference
download_vlm_model: download a HuggingFace vision-language model to a local cache directory for offline use
